summary: Social-discussion snapshot: high chatter about Claude Code adoption, Copilot security, Opencode/Ox Alpha instabilities, plus multiple infra primitives (MCP, sandbox, durable storage) and operator workflow reports. | Vendor-only screening: highlights include Anthropic Opus 5, Mistral studio/vibe launches, Cloudflare MCP/security updates, AWS guidance for S3 multi-agent orchestration; gaps note missing social/operator reports. | GitHub OSS snapshot: large agent platforms and releases (Qwen, Vercel agent-browser, FastGPT, Dify, OpenAI/Anthropic releases); rising infra primitives for sandboxing, MCP security, and cross-agent memory; several single-repo agent projects need corroboration. | Package-registry snapshot: mix of vendor agent packages (OpenAI, Amazon, Vercel) and many lightweight infra primitives (MCP servers, memory layers, eval/tracing tools). No social/operator reports in this shard—corroboration needed for many PyPI/npm-only projects.
